verdict.rationale: Runpod gives you building blocks for background work: a REST API for integrating GPU compute into 'workflows and automation systems', Pods that keep long-running processes going over SSH, Serverless endpoints that scale to zero, and cluster job deployment. Nothing in the evidence shows a native automation feature, so scheduling and orchestration would have to come from outside tools. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/cron or event triggers, a native workflow/automation builder, documented autonomous background-job orchestration, independent hands-on corroboration.
